title: Mean of the binary inner product sign
statement: For every $m\in\mathbb N$, the uniform expectation over pairs $(u,v)\in\mathbb F_2^m\times\mathbb F_2^m$ of $(-1)^{u\cdot v}$ is $2^{-m}$, where the dot product is computed modulo two.
